title: RistoApp WorkSpace launch-readiness smoke
goal: Read the public README and produce a concise, evidence-based snapshot of RistoApp's current product promise, likely launch audience, immediate launch-readiness gaps and the next three concrete operating actions. Do not invent product capabilities or traction.
acceptance: [AC1] Ground the summary in the repository README and clearly separate facts from assumptions.
[AC2] Identify concrete launch-readiness gaps rather than generic startup advice.
[AC3] End with exactly three prioritized next actions that can feed the next WorkSpace cycle.
